title: Ombudsman dismisses Dagupan treasurer over alleged P1M ‘ghost’ purchase
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Wednesday said it had ordered the dismissal of a Dagupan City treasurer over the alleged “ghost” purchase of two wooden motorboats…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Wednesday said it had ordered the dismissal of a Dagupan City treasurer over the alleged “ghost” purchase of two wooden motorboats worth almost P1 million. Romelita Fonseca Alcantara was also stripped of her retirement benefits, disqualified from holding public office, and had her civil service eligibility canceled. The anti-graft body found her administratively liable for grave misconduct for causing the release of P999,750 in public funds as full payment for two motorboats that were never delivered to the city government.
